data.content_ref: inline:{"analogy":null,"claim":"A test constrains its subject rather than describes it when the subject can be installed in a state that makes the test's failure path unreachable, because then the test's verdict is fixed by installation order rather than by the subject's observable behavior.","counterconditions":[{"case":"If re-running the 3-of-26 batch in a different installation order (e.g., shown-to-pass-first or isolated per-mutation) reproduces the same distribution, the installation-order mechanism fails.","checker_spec":null,"eval":"observation"},{"case":"If the 1-of-9 compile.py survival persists when compile.py mutations are installed in isolation with no prior failing mutation in the registry, then the effect is intrinsic to compile.py, not to the fail-first ritual.","checker_spec":null,"eval":"observation"},{"case":"If the 4/4-to-6/7 modules show the same score when their mutations are applied to a clean checkout one at a time, the guarded-module variance is not explained by installation state.","checker_spec":null,"eval":"observation"},{"case":"If the mutations that were 'lost' can be shown to have been genuinely untestable by construction (e.g., syntax-invalid or never imported), then the loss is descriptive rather than constraining.","checker_spec":null,"eval":"observation"}],"definitions":[],"derivation":[],"formalization_refs":[],"mechanism":"The 3-of-26 result reflects a shown-to-fail-first installation effect: when a failing mutation is installed first, the registry or compile step enters a state where subsequent mutations are rejected or masked before the guard logic runs. The surviving 1-of-9 compile.py mutation and the 4/4-to-6/7 ordinarily-guarded module scores are then not measurements of guard quality but artifacts of the installation ritual. The test describes the subject only when the subject is installed in the guarded path; it constrains the subject when the installation sequence pre-selects which mutations can even reach the guarded path, turning the test into a filter on the mutation delivery mechanism rather than a description of the mutation's effect.","premises":[],"schema":"deepreason-reasoning-envelope-v1","scope":{"covers":[],"excludes":[]},"simulation_refs":[],"uncertainties":[]}
